title: Surreal Ballet by the River
description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts two ballerinas in flowing colorful dresses performing a dramatic lift above a reflective body of water with swirling psychedelic patterns. In the foreground, a rat sits on a wooden dock beside a VS neon sign and a shop display of pink garments, while a glowing lantern and palm trees frame the colorful sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of two graceful ballerinas in ornate colorful tutus performing an acrobatic lift above a reflective river with swirling psychedelic patterns and reflections. One ballerina has green hair. In the foreground a black rat sits on a wooden pier next to a pink VS neon sign, a clothing rack with pink garments, and a glowing lantern on a flower post. Background features palm trees, forest, and a dramatic pink and green cloudy sky, vibrant colors, detailed digital painting.
